# Linear Wipe

**Wipe › Linear** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (8–60)

A straight edge sweeps across the frame at any angle, hard or soft. Split mode opens from the middle like barn doors.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/linear-wipe@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Changes of place
- Before/after reveals
- Slide-like presentations

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import linearWipe from './transitions/03-wipe/linear/linear-wipe';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(linearWipe, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `angle` | number | `90` | 0–360 | Direction the edge travels, in degrees (90 = left to right). |
| `softness` | number | `0` | 0–40 | Edge softness, as a percentage of the frame. |
| `mode` | enum | `"single"` | `single` · `split` | single: one edge. split: two edges open from the centre. |

## Presets

| Id | Name | Params |
|---|---|---|
| `soft` | Soft edge | `{"softness":18}` |
| `barn-door` | Barn door | `{"mode":"split"}` |
| `diagonal` | Diagonal | `{"angle":135}` |
